identity.title: List of English language Pokémon the Series: XY home video releases (Region 4)

leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the seventeenth season of , Pokémon the Series: XY, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the seventeenth season of , Pokémon the Series: XY, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
Two Pokémon the Series: XY Collections were released by in 2014 and 2015, containing the whole season between them (after Collection 2 was reprinted with episodes it was missing). The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

===Pokémon the Series: XY - Collection 1===
 
Pokémon the Series: XY - Collection 1 was released by in Australia and New Zealand on December 3, 2014. It contains three discs with 23 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE5509.

====Contents====
 

===Pokémon the Series: XY - Collection 2===
 
Pokémon the Series: XY - Collection 1 was released by in Australia on February 2, 2015 and in New Zealand on February 18, 2015. It contains three discs with 21 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE5510. It is missing the last four episodes of the season (The Clumsy Crier Quiets the Chaos!, Dreaming a Performer's Dream!, A Campus Reunion!, and Bonnie for the Defense!).

This disc set was re-released by Beyond Home Entertainment sometime before March 28, 2015 with the missing episodes and the catalogue number BHE6242 (the discs retain the former number). It contains three discs with 25 episodes across them combined (the back of the case now specifies 25 episodes rather than 21). Customers could also exchange the old DVD release for the new corrected one.

====Contents====
=====BHE5510=====
 

=====BHE6242=====
 

==Season 17 disc set==
 
The Season 17 DigiPack disc set was released by in Australia on June 3, 2015 and in New Zealand on June 10, 2015. It contains six discs with 48 episodes across them. Its catalogue number is BHE6106. The DigiPack disc set was re-released exclusive to JB Hi-Fi online on July 14, 2016 and in JB Hi-Fi stores on September 21, 2016 to celebrate the Pokémon 20th Anniversary. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

This disc set was re-released by Beyond Home Entertainment in a slimline case on August 18, 2015 with a different cover and the catalogue number BHE6107.

===Contents===
Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself.
 
 

==Sample disc==
 
A sample disc DVD of the series was released in 2014 by . It contains 3 episodes, and its catalogue number is BHE5867.

==Multi-season releases==
The following are English language Region 4 multi-season releases that include Pokémon the Series: XY episodes.
Pokémon Seasons 1-19: Deluxe Edition
Pokémon Seasons 1-20: Ultra Collection
Pokémon Seasons 1-21: Mega Collection
